title: Mauryan economy, society, art: more detail

boxes.title: Economy: added terms
items: **Drona** ≈ **13.2** kg water, near granaries, for six regions; **Dronavapa** = land sown with one drona of seed
**Pindakara**: groups of villages; **Kara**: orchards; **Hiranya**: cash only
Officials: Samaharta, Gopa, Sthanika; famine relief: seed, cattle, tools
Mines under **Akaradhyaksha**; iron = one basis of ==Magadhan power==
Debt relief for students, poor, sick; **Suvarna** = gold coin
Punch-marked coins (peacocks, hills) + NBPW found to Bangladesh, Odisha, Andhra, Karnataka
Guilds (**shrenis**) financed Buddhist centres in Andhra; shreni troops in army

boxes.title: Trade: added
items: Caravans led by a ==**Sarthavaha**==; road tax for protection
Northern routes: Shravasti-Rajgir, Shravasti-Pratishthan, Rajgir-Sindhu-Sauvira
Centres: Kashi, Ujjain, **Kaushambi**, Takshashila
Partners: Greece, Persia, Syria, Sri Lanka, **Java**, **Sumatra**
Exports: diamonds, pearls, **muslin**

boxes.title: Society: added
items: Seven classes: philosophers, farmers, herdsmen, artisans, soldiers, overseers, councillors; hereditary + endogamy
Megasthenes: theft rare; Andhras **30** walled towns (⚠ other notes: 80)
**Antyavasayin**: five mixed castes; learned men = ==**Sishtas**==
Slavery by birth, sale, war, **judicial punishment**; no Arya a slave
**Karmakaras** = wage labour; **anuloma**/**pratiloma** marriages
Divorce for deserted wife (UPSC **1996**); Bhadrabahu's **Kalpasutra**

boxes.title: Art & pillars: added
items: Two streams: **royal** (court) vs **folk** (yaksha, terracotta)
Yakshas = ==earliest large-scale human sculptures==; folk origin
**Lohanipur**: nude male torso
Pillar sites: Rampurva, **Lauriya Araraj**, Vaishali, Kaushambi, **Sankisa** (elephant)
Capital parts: **Mekhala** (band), **Shirsha** (animal); Mauryan polish like NBPW

boxes.title: Palace, caves, chronology
items: Palace compared to **Susa**, **Ecbatana**; admired by **Fa-Hien**
Kumrahar hall: **8** rows x **10**; city mainly **timber**
Barabar: **Lomas Rishi**, **Sudama**, Viswamitra, Karna Chopar; Nagarjuni: Vahiyaka, **Gopika** (largest), Vadathika
Inscriptions call Ashoka "King Piyadasi"; ⚠ not Nagarjunakonda (Guntur)
Dhauli elephant earlier than Udayagiri Varaha, Mahabalipuram, Lingaraja (UPSC **2015**)
Bharhut = most ancient stupa (some notes); ==**Bhattiprolu**== = oldest in Andhra

boxes.title: In the news
items: **Balirajgarh** (Madhubani): Mauryan to Pala habitation (Apr **2026**)
**Vaishya Tekri** (Ujjain): dig resumes after ~**90** years; stupa possibly larger than Sanchi
Mauryan rain records predate Korea's **Cheugugi** (**1441**); **Guntupalli** chaitya compared with Barabar
